limits: Static PE evidence proves only the observed technology candidate scope and exact value member; no engine runtime acceptance.
The first three evaluator slots all contain the same country scope; their ROOT/THIS/FROM names were not independently decoded.
Eligibility precedes base evaluation. Original cost, random, tie, command validation and enqueue remain engine-owned; base zero is not a terminal rejection.
The fifth argument remains opaque auxiliary; no named technology scope, generic reader or arbitrary lowering is authorized.
Cost overflow arithmetic and command virtual semantics are retained as raw whole ranges, not fully algebraically decompiled.
The bounded xref scan excludes arbitrary dataflow, indirect calls and inlining; it does not authorize other consumers or close A4-1.
